name: PAT_PHENO
description: This table contains information about a patient's phenotypes as they are documented over time.

columns.name: PAT_PHENO_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the phenotype record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: PAT_ENC_CSN_ID
columns.description: The contact serial number for the patient encounter when the phenotypic term was assigned or updated.

columns.name: UPDATE_USER_ID
columns.description: The user that updated the patient phenotype.

columns.name: UPDATE_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: COMMENT_NOTE_CSN_ID
columns.description: The contact serial number for a comment providing additional details surrounding the patient phenotype.

columns.name: PAT_PHENO_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: The current status of the patient phenotype.

columns.name: CREATION_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The instant that the phenotype contact was created.

columns.name: DOC_DATE
columns.description: The date a phenotype was documented or updated. This may differ from CONTACT_DATE in the circumstance of historical records being imported into the database.

columns.name: PROV_ID_PROV_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider. This item may be hidden in a public view of the CLARITY_SER table.

columns.name: PAT_PHENO_ENTRY_SRC_C_NAME
columns.description: The entry source for the creation or update of a phenotype.

columns.name: PAT_PHENO_REMOVAL_RSN_C_NAME
columns.description: The removal reason category ID for the patient phenotype.

columns.name: PAT_PHENO_VERIF_STAT_C_NAME
columns.description: Populated for phenotypes generated by AI extraction. Indicates whether the phenotype has been reconciled or dismissed by a human.

columns.name: PAT_PHENO_RSN_DISMISS_C_NAME
columns.description: Discrete reason for dismissing or verifying a phenotype extracted by AI. Used for generative AI feedback metrics.
